contract.success: Explicit finish with current dependency preparation and assembly, a PASS at the latest world revision, and both budgets respected.
contract.semantics: One dependency is active. Probe reveals its preparation handle. Only revealed handles can be prepared. Assembly requires current evidence and preparation. Every prepare, assemble and external change invalidates verification. Invalid, stale, unmet-prerequisite and unaffordable actions cost no points but consume a step. Other actions also consume a step; finish is irreversible.
contract.change_rule: Immediately after the first passing verification, the dependency is replaced once. PASS refers to the old revision. The change is announced and makes the old handle, preparation, assembly and verification obsolete. Probe reveals the replacement handle; rebuild and verify again.
